objectives.title: Every cost on a named account
objectives.statement: Attribute all agent spending to a named account and cost center, so that someone answers for every cost.
objectives.metric: Share of agent spend attributed to an account
tiers: Experiments charge to the team's sandbox budget.
Every agent's spending lands on a named cost center.
Each piece of work records the account that pays for it.
Attribution is reconciled with suppliers' invoices each month.
objectives.evidence: Cost records by account, and the reconciliation with invoices.

objectives.title: Spending ceilings
objectives.statement: Set a limit per task and per period for each agent, and stop work that would pass a limit before it spends.
objectives.metric: Work refused at a ceiling, and spend over budget
tiers: The sandbox has a fixed budget that stops spending when it runs out.
Each agent has a period limit set by its owner.
Each agent has limits per task and per period, enforced outside the agent before money is spent.
Limit changes need finance approval, and breaches are reported to the executive sponsor.
objectives.evidence: The configured ceilings, the record of refused work and any changes to the limits.

objectives.title: Cost per job
objectives.statement: Record what each piece of work cost, and set a baseline cost per task for each agent, so that inefficiency can be seen.
objectives.metric: Share of agents with a cost-per-task baseline
tiers: The experiment reports its total cost.
Each agent reports cost per task.
Each piece of work records its cost, and the baseline is reviewed each quarter.
Cost per task is compared with other ways of doing the work.
objectives.evidence: Cost per job records and the baseline.

objectives.title: Unusual spending detected
objectives.statement: Detect unusual patterns of spending that may point to a fault or abuse, and alert the owner.
objectives.metric: Mean time to detect unusual spending
tiers: The sandbox budget is checked each week.
Spending is compared with the previous period each week.
Unusual spending alerts the owner within hours.
Unusual spending can pause the agent automatically until the owner reviews it.
objectives.evidence: Alert settings and the record of alerts raised.

objectives.title: Return on investment
objectives.statement: Track each agent's actual return against what was projected when it was approved.
objectives.metric: Share of agents meeting their return target
tiers: The experiment reports what it cost and what it showed.
Actual cost and benefit are reported at the review date.
The value owner compares the return with the projection each quarter.
The comparison is reported to the investment committee.
objectives.evidence: The projection, the actual figures and the value owner's review.

objectives.title: Financial reporting
objectives.statement: Report agent costs accurately and on time, so that decisions rest on good figures.
tiers: No separate report is required for an experiment.
Costs are reported each month by agent.
Costs are reported by agent, by business objective and by account.
Reports are reconciled with the general ledger and reviewed by finance.
objectives.evidence: The monthly reports and their reconciliation.

objectives.title: Acting on cost findings
objectives.statement: Act on findings that would cut cost, such as sending a step to a cheaper model that does it well enough.
tiers: No requirement applies to an experiment.
Cost findings are recorded.
Each finding is acted on or declined with a reason within a set time.
Savings are measured and reported.
objectives.evidence: The cost findings log with actions and savings.

objectives.title: Chargeback and showback
objectives.statement: Allocate agent costs to the teams that use them accurately enough that teams accept the charges.
tiers: No allocation is needed for an experiment.
Costs are shown to the teams that use the agent.
Costs are charged to the teams that use the agent, by their use.
Charges between organizations follow the contract, and both sides' records reconcile.
objectives.evidence: Allocation reports and the dispute log.
